column2: Great Comrade!, we have defeated the allied armies in Belgium, however, the allied leaders have escaped from us. Drink some Vodka with me for celebrate the victory!
North Italy - September 15th, 1945
Comrade Commander, we want to resume our offensive in the north of Italy.
There shouldn't be any strong resistance there but maybe you´ll find some German units scattered, so be careful.
Very good, we have now a strong presence in Italy, the allies didn´t expected the combined attack againt France and Italy, furthermore they were unable to divide their forces wisely.
Italy Coast - October 1st, 1945
Commander, continue with your unstoppable attack in Italy, now we are getting close to the dream of a united Europe by Comunism and ruled by Comrade Stalin, "the little father of all peoples".
Playing tip : place amphibious ships on any adjacent hex to the coast in order to deploy your troops whenever you want (one unique ship can deploy your whole army).

Oh, Commander, come on in. Well, it's almost over. We want you to capture the experimental airbase here at Dessau before the Commies can get there and before the Krauts can destroy everything else. Now, there's nothing complicated about this, just get there, fast. Good luck.

There are only few steps left to gain the control of whole Europe. It´s well known that the allies know nothing about defence and we have borne the weight of the war against Germany, this is an invaluable experience.
Commander, your last defeat had a terrible impact over the Members,
the situation isn´t lost after all, but you are relieved of your
command for the time being.
Soviet campaign: 1945-1946
Gameset: USSR 46
Longest path: 31
Campaign designer: Pablo Schlegel & Santiago Fuertes, 24/12/2002
PeGWW2 conversion: Robert Mary, 04/2006
The tension between USSR and USA has reached a critical point.
Command the Red army for the glory of Mother Russia and achieve Stalin's dream.
The WEST BANK General, I wanted us on the WEST BANK!
Your performance was unacceptable.
Herr General, this defeat is out of the question, thanks to your stupidity the whole plan was unsuccessful.
They cut our supply lines and our soldiers are between the wall and the sword.
Due to the impossibility to proceed to reinforcements through the channel, we have only one choice, surrender all our troops in the Island.

Excellent work, Commander. You've got the Krauts high-tailing it back to the fatherland. Looks like you might get another star for this one. I heard you were right up there with your boys!  Good job, good job, son.
Well isn't this ironic.
Once again the decisive battle will be fought in Stalingrad.
The Germans failed to take this city in 1942.
We shall not share their fate.
The Brits are driving from the West and should link up with your forces.
Once you do, we will have isolated Ivan's remaining forces.
End this war and do it now.
The whole world is watching General, do not disappoint me.
US Campaign 1945-1946
Equipment: European E-File or European'46 E-File
Gameset: USA 46
PeG-WW2 Campaign Designer: Mark Kirby, June 2005
International tensions boil over into a full blown Russian invasion of
Western Europe. You must stop the Soviets from over running Germany.
That was magnificent.
You seized the ports intact.
Our forces are pouring in now.
Ah General, come in.
No doubt you are aware of the situation in Europe.  The front has
become a stalemate.
Our strategic air power has kept Ivan from building up his forces
sufficiently to resume his offensive, however, his defense is strong
enough that we can't break through without suffering massive casualties.
Therefore, our strategic goal has changed here in the Far East.
Right now we have an advantage here and we must exploit it.
Our new mission is to take the Eastern end of the trans-Siberian railroad
in Vladivostok, and drive west along its length.
This will force Ivan to transfer forces East which should allow us to
resume the offensive in Europe.
We have to seize a beach head and move inland quickly.
General, that was pathetic.
You need to do better when we take Vladivostok.
Well done General.
We can now build up our forces for the seizure of Vladivostok.
Rumble at Khabarovsk
Soviet forces try and stop the Allied advance at Khabarovsk
Well, you gave Ivan a bloody nose, but some of his forces escaped.
This will make our drive west more difficult than I hoped.
Advance to Ulan Ude
Allied Forces continue their drive west at Ulan Ude
Good. .
You didn't cut it, but our forces are close enough that they won't be able
to use it as freely.
G2 has a rumor that Stalin is so concerned with our efforts here that he's
named you an "Enemy of the State" and has dispatched Zhukov to stop
I suggest you have that meeting further to the west.
Well Done.
keep the pressure up and keep moving west.
Battle For Irkutsk
The Allies flank Lake Baikal
Mr Churchill, we are withdrawing everything we can over the Nile. We can only hope to hold the line at the Suez Canal. Alexandria and Cario are not defensible with the forces at hand.
Yes, sir, as far as we know his entire command was captured or wiped out. Yes, sir, it is a shame.
What's the matter General, can't hack it against the first team?
Zhukovs good, but you are supposed to be better.
Don't fail me again.
General, if we let Ivan get settled, this front will stalemate just like
Europe.
You have to do better than this next time.
Zhukovs the real deal and you did well against him.
Keep moving West
Breakout at Almaty
The Allies breakout of the mountains onto the Steppes

Congratulations!  Winston is pleased by your performance.  The capture of Sicily is almost assured. Commander, you have exceeded all expectations. Your mastery of the art of war continues to dismay our enemies.
General, didn't you understand my orders?
Ivan got most of his forces into the mountains, and now we've got to use
precious forces to garrison our rear areas.
You better get your shit together
Envelopment at Ekaterinburg
The Allies surround Soviet forces at Ekaterinburg
Well General, you did it.
Stalin is furious over this and the Kremlin said quite a few senior officers
have the flu.  G2 reports that this may make the purges of the 30's look
like a summer holiday.
Let's take advantage of this distraction and drive West.
Ivan has chosen to make a stand here at Ekaterinburg.
If we get past them, we'll be out of the Urals and into European Russia.
Stalin has vowed this will never happen.
Let's show him what we think of his "proclamations"
By the way, our efforts out here are starting to pay off.  G2 in Europe reports that Stalin is withdrawing forces from Poland to send against us.
They should be able to resume the offensive soon.
Close General, very close.
Please don't stress my heart like that any more.
The Allies Meet stiff resistance at Kazan
At this rate we could be home by Christmas
Well general, it would seem Ivan doesn't want us to get to Berlin.
That was close but you pulled it off.
Keep the pressure on Ivan, he's beginning to crack.
The Allies continue their drive on Astrakhan
With our flank secure, we can continue our advance.
General, I am losing my patience with you.
We cannot afford such failures.
Good job, you dealt with Ivan's forces.
Time to head West again.
The final showdown at Stalingrad
General, I am speechless.
They will be studying this battle at the Point for centuries to come.
Word out of Moscow is that Stalin died of a "heart attack".
A new Troika has formed and is asking for terms.
The war is over!
That defeat has galvanized Soviet forces across the map.
They have launched a counterattack and cut our rear.
We are isolated just like the Sixth Army in 42.
There's nothing available to come to our relief.
I have no choice but to ask for terms.
WWII ½: Fulda Gap - June 13, 1945
Come on in General.
I'm giving you the top job in this sector.
If Ivan gets through the Fulda Gap, he'll take Frankfurt and we'll have no place to stop him before the Rhine.
That would make me very unhappy.
The engineers have prepared good defensive positions for you, make
the most of them.
That was a very close run thing, but you held
You've cut Ivan's supply line and withstood the best he could throw at
The King himself wants to decorate you!  That will have to wait however,
as I've got work for you here.

You have hurt the Axis badly, but they have managed to withdraw to Sicily.  Unfortunately, we do not have the resources to invade Sicily at this time.  The war in the Med will continue.  Commander, you are to return to England immediately.
US Forces surround Berlin
WWII ½: Counterattack Part 2
Outstanding General,
With Berlin cutoff, Monty was able to take Berlin easily.
WWII ½: Isolate Berlin - July 24, 1945
General, I've got a tough assignment for you.
Ivan is sending massive reinforcements to Berlin.
I need you to drive north, take the Seelowe Heights and hold them.
Monty assures me that if you hold, he will take Berlin.
Commander, you have exceeded our expectations.  The enemy fought valiantly, but this did not stop you.  More defeats like this will finish the Germans!
August 2, 1945
US Forces drive into Poland
General, you better pick up the pace.
If you don't Ivan's going to fully recover and ruin my day.
it would appear I can spare you.
Invasion Sakhalin
Outstanding work general.
We've now got a firm base for future operations.
Commander, our beachhead is secure.  This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed at SHAEF headquarters.
Very good work general.
We've now got a base for future operations.
The Road to Fulda
June 7, 1945
Allied Forces fight a mobile defensive battle against advancing Russian
Congratulations!  Brilliant performance.  All of Austria is now open to attack. The Third Reich is sure to fall soon.
WWII ½: Fulda Prelude - June 7, 1945
Good evening General, I don't have to tell you that the situation isn't going well.
Ivan is driving towards Frankfurt, and we've got to stop him.
The engineers are preparing defensive positions near Fulda, but they
need more time.
You've got to delay Ivan for at least a few days or we'll have to swim to England.
The French have surrendered and resistance has collapsed. Your performance has been adequate. Thank you, Commander.
Allied forces begin their drive to Berlin
Amazing General,
You went through Ivan like shit through a goose.
Now we retake Berlin
WWII ½: On to Berlin - July 15, 1945
General, youve drawn the assignment to punch a hole through the
Soviet lines and open the road to Berlin.
The Brits are sending support from your left, they should be here by
morning.
Intelligence reports Ivan's moving two entire tanks armies to stop you so watch your flanks.
Keep this up and you'll be fighting Japs before you know it.
Congratulations General, that was well done.
This puts us in a good position to assault Berlin
Conflict between the USSR and The Western Allies breaks out on the
WWII ½: Elbe - June 1, 1945
General, come in, have a seat.
You've seen the intelligence reports about the buildup our "friends" are
making across the river?
Washington says it's all just posturing for the negotiating table and with a
war still going on in the Pacific, I hope they're right.
In any event, I want you to.............................Hold on a minute
Well that does it.  We have reports of Soviet paratroops landing at
multiple locations on our side of the Elbe.  It looks like Ivan wasn't bluffing
after all.
